items.evidence: Operating Income Per Barrel of crude oil throughput compared to a group of peer companies
Adjusted EBITDA per Share is a non-GAAP performance metric derived from our consolidated financial statements.
Distributable Cash Flow at MPLX per Unit is a non-GAAP measure reflecting cash flow available to be paid to MPLX's common unitholders
Added a new Refining Operating Costs metric
Created an ESG metric with quantitative goals tied to greenhouse gas emissions intensity and diversity, equity & inclusion
Process Safety Events Rate measures our ability to identify, understand and control certain process hazards.
Designated Environmental Incidents measures environmental performance through tracking Tier #and #incidents.
Diversity, Equity & Inclusion measures our effectiveness toward reaching our five-year representation goals
MPC PSUs align our NEOs' long-term compensation interests with our shareholders' long-term investment interests by conditioning payout on the performance of our TSR relative to that of our peers
MPLX performance units pay out based on MPLX's total unitholder return ("TUR") performance relative to a peer group of midstream companies
DCF attributable to MPLX is measured for each year of a three-year performance cycle
